PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post L4-L5, No Heavy Spinal Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength without heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation and Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Hinge + Core Bracing":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust_barbell 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          45_degree_back_extension_bodyweight 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_pulldown_neutral_grip 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat_front_rack_dumbbells 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press_cable 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_5_percent_incline 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push Pull + Anti-Flexion":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          landmine_press_half_kneeling 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown_supinated 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_carry_trap_handles 4x30m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_back_mobility_flow 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Knee + Glutes":
        warmup:
          elliptical 6m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_feet_high 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
